title: Music City's West End Retreat 10 Min To Broadway
description:
Welcome to Music City’s West End Retreat, a stylish 2nd floor one-bedroom Nashville condo inspired by the legendary Man in Black and perfectly located in the heart of Music City. With luxury furnishings, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location just steps from Centennial Park and The Parthenon, this condo is the perfect home base for your Nashville getaway. We're just 10 minutes from World Famous Broadway!

The space
Whether you're visiting Vanderbilt or Belmont, exploring Broadway’s famous honky-tonks, attending a concert, or traveling for work, this beautifully appointed space places you just minutes from everything that makes Nashville special.

The condo blends elevated comfort with iconic Nashville style, featuring tasteful Johnny Cash themed décor and a welcoming atmosphere designed for relaxation after a day exploring the city.

Sleeping Arrangements
• Primary Bedroom: King Bed 
• Living Room: Full sized cot 
Perfect for couples, solo travelers, business guests, or small groups looking for a comfortable Nashville stay near downtown.

Unbeatable Nashville Location
One of the best things about this condo is the walkable West End location, surrounded by restaurants, coffee shops, and parks while still being just minutes from downtown Nashville.

Walk To
• Centennial Park & The Parthenon – 5 minutes 
• Maggiano’s Little Italy – 4 minutes 
• BrickTop’s – 6 minutes 
• Starbucks, Taziki’s, Bellagio Pizza, 51st Ave Deli, Ted's Montana Grill, and so much more – all within 10 minutes

Quick Ride To
• Vanderbilt University – 4 minutes 
• Belmont University – 5 minutes 
• Music Row – 6 minutes 
• The Gulch – 8 minutes 
• Broadway Honky Tonks – under 10 minutes 
• Bridgestone Arena – 9 minutes 
• Ryman Auditorium – 9 minutes • Nissan Stadium – 10 minutes 
• Nashville International Airport (BNA) – 14 minutes

This central location makes it easy to experience live music, sporting events, college visits, and Nashville’s famous food scene. Designed for comfort and convenience, our space includes everything needed for a smooth and relaxing stay, it's also ideal for people in town for work or needing to stay near Vanderbilt Hospital. 

Amenities include: 
• Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances (please note cooking oil is not provided) 
• In-unit washer and dryer with detergent provided 
• Fresh linens, extra pillows, and cozy blankets 
• Bathroom essentials including shampoo, conditioner, and body wash 
• Hair dryer, iron, hangers, and other travel necessities 
• Clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully curated interiors
• Smart TVs (use your own app log ins)

After a day exploring Nashville, unwind in a quiet, comfortable retreat that celebrates the spirit of Johnny Cash, The Ryman, and Music City.
